<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914597_theRebbe_351" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914597_theRebbe_351__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the reason this concept is stated regarding Noach is because Noach is connected to teshuvah, which reveals the essence of the soul, and this is reflected in the double phrase "Noach Noach" and the interpretation of "teshuvah and good deeds."</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that the reason this matter is stated regarding Noach,</t>
    <t s="2">is,</t>
    <t s="3">that Noach is connected to teshuvah</t>
    <t s="4">[for Noach's service caused the statement "I will not again... nor will they cease"47],</t>
    <t s="5">for through teshuvah there is a revelation of the essence of the soul48.</t>
    <t s="6">And therefore it is stated about him "Noach Noach" twice,</t>
    <t s="7">a single matter that includes two aspects: rest for the supernal beings and rest for the lower beings.</t>
    <t s="8">And one can connect this with the well-known explanation49</t>
    <t s="9">of the language of our sages50</t>
    <t s="10">"teshuvah and good deeds,"</t>
    <t s="11">that through teshuvah the deeds become</t>
    <t s="12">(the deeds of the mitzvos)</t>
    <t s="13">good deeds and luminous51,</t>
    <t s="14">for "deeds" is the body of the mitzvah and "good" is the light and vitality of the mitzvah</t>
    <t s="15">(the intention of the mitzvos),</t>
    <t s="16">and through teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="17">through which there is a revelation of the essence of the soul,</t>
    <t s="18">the deeds</t>
    <t s="19">(of the mitzvos)</t>
    <t s="20">themselves are good and luminous,</t>
    <t s="21">for the intention from the aspect of the essence of the soul shines within them in revelation.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section expresses the wish that through the third Shabbos meal and the Torah reading of Noach, there should be rest from all distractions, leading to a new world and the building of the third Beis HaMikdash, which corresponds to Yaakov and includes the first two.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And may it be His will,</t>
    <t s="2">that since we are now in the third meal of Shabbos, which is connected to Minchah of Shabbos,</t>
    <t s="3">and especially since the Torah reading of Minchah of this Shabbos is "These are the generations of Noach, Noach,"</t>
    <t s="4">there should be rest from all matters that confuse one in the service of G-d,</t>
    <t s="5">both regarding matters of the body and regarding matters of the soul,</t>
    <t s="6">and as above</t>
    <t s="7">(section 3)</t>
    <t s="8">that the rest of Minchah of Shabbos includes both matters.</t>
    <t s="9">And since "He has placed the world in the heart of man"52,</t>
    <t s="10">through this rest will be drawn also into all the worlds,</t>
    <t s="11">rest for the supernal beings and rest for the lower beings</t>
    <t s="12">(as above section 1).</t>
    <t s="13">And moreover,</t>
    <t s="14">that just as Noach saw a new world53</t>
    <t s="15">(in addition to there being rest in all the worlds,</t>
    <t s="16">there was also a renewal in the world),</t>
    <t s="17">so may we merit very soon a new world,</t>
    <t s="18">the new heavens and the new earth54,</t>
    <t s="19">and especially after the Torah reading</t>
    <t s="20">(in the morning)</t>
    <t s="21">of "In the beginning G-d created the heavens and the earth"55,</t>
    <t s="22">for through this we effect that the Holy One, blessed be He, creates anew the heavens and the earth and all their hosts.</t>
    <t s="23">And very soon there will be the building of the third Beis HaMikdash, which corresponds to Yaakov56,</t>
    <t s="24">in which are also included the first and second Beis HaMikdash57</t>
    <t s="25">which correspond to Avraham and Yitzchak56</t>
    <t s="26">— analogous to Minchah of Shabbos and the third meal of Shabbos,</t>
    <t s="27">the inheritance of Yaakov58,</t>
    <t s="28">which includes also the two Shabbosos of erev Shabbos and the day of Shabbos.</t>
    <t s="29">And furthermore, and primarily,</t>
    <t s="30">that all this will be very soon,</t>
    <t s="31">very soon.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
